chose: scaffold control on a named request reads a scoped reading that stands only when scopedUnsettled settles the core-dependency and column facts over every tree the unread interfaces allow, else reads whole
over: a scoped reading taken as is, whose core dependencies and columns are counted only over the interfaces it read and can differ from the whole reading's
because: flowOf's route rule reads two facts counted over every interface (core dependency, column) and the route's mates; reading the components a route enters makes the route's own facts exact, and interval bounds from the word index make the rest provable or fall back, so the proposal is the whole reading's by construction
